id: title:VojtechBartos:gate desktop deep link by access

review.posthog_relevance: Adds UI capability and state management for PostHog Desktop access checks, allowing the desktop application to distinguish users with Desktop access and render the appropriate integration link.
review.reason: Adds a new API route mock, loader, selectors, and actions to check PostHog Desktop access, and conditionally renders the Desktop link only when access is granted. P1.F4.H5 adds the access check helper and conditional rendering; P1.F4.H6 adds the loader and state management. This is a localized, bounded implementation of a specific UI capability.
review.uncertainty: The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation of a bounded UI capability. No evidence exists regarding actual user adoption, backend implementation, or production benefit. The score does not account for unverified outcomes or the broader impact of this feature.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a new API route mock and its corresponding loader, selectors, and actions to check PostHog Desktop access, and conditionally renders the Desktop link only when access is granted.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether the authenticated user has access to PostHog Desktop and exposes this capability to the TaskTracker scene, allowing the UI to show an 'Open in PostHog Desktop' link only for eligible users.

observations.behavior: Adds a loader and its associated actions to fetch Desktop access status, and a selector to derive the boolean access state.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides a mechanism to asynchronously retrieve Desktop access status and store it in the scene's state, supporting the conditional rendering and potential future backend implementation.
